(When converted to [[Dungeon Item]]) }} The '''Midas' Sword''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Sword]] that can be obtained from the [[Dark Auction]]. It increases in power as more {{coins}} are spent on it by the player, maxing at {{c|50M|short=yes}} (or {{c|250M|short=yes}} when [[#Upgrading|upgraded]]). == Obtaining == === Dark Auction === The '''Midas' Sword''' can be obtained from the [[Dark Auction]] round 1, 3 or 4, costing a minimum of {{c|100k|short=yes}} to purchase. == Usage == |-|Midas' Sword = {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Midas' Sword |rarity = l |damage = 170 |item_ability_name = Greed |item_ability_description = The strength and damage bonus of this

{{Statname|Strength}} Bonus: {{Red|225}} }} When purchased from the [[Dark Auction]], it gains a {{Stat|dmg}} and {{Stat|str}} bonus based on how much the winner paid for it. The maximum possible buff is {{Stat|dmg|+120}} and {{Stat|str|+120}} at {{c|50m}} paid. For the fragged version, it is {{Stat|dmg|+225}} and {{Stat|str|+225}} at {{c|250m}} paid. A [[Golden Dragon Pet]] also buffs the ability by up to {{Green|10%}}. {{Calculator:Midas' Sword damage}} == Upgrading == The '''Midas' Sword''' can be upgraded to the '''{{Fragged}} Midas' Sword''' with {{Item|Golden Fragment|amount=8}}s, allowing the price paid to be increased to {{c|250000000}}. {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |name = [[Midas' Sword|{{Fragged}} Midas' Sword]] |A1 = Golden Fragment |B1 = Golden Fragment |C1 = Golden Fragment |A2 = Golden Fragment |B2 = Midas' Sword |C2 = Golden Fragment |A3 = Golden Fragment |B3 = Golden Fragment |C3 = Golden Fragment |Output = Midas' Sword (fragged) }} }} == Essence Crafting == This weapon can be upgraded using Gold Essence. Once converted, it requires {{Skill|Catacombs|17}} to use while in [[Dungeons]]. {{Essence Crafting |25|50|75|125|200 |c = 100 |essence=Gold |type=weapon }} == Trivia == *The minimum price required to gain the maximum stat buff without using {{NPCSprite|Zarina}} is {{c|50,040,000}}, or {{c|250,520,000}} for the fragged version. **It is possible to increase the price paid at {{NPCSprite|Zarina}} after the fact, however this has an additional cost of {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=3}}. *There are a few Midas' Swords with price paid values not possible through the [[Dark Auction]]. **{{RN|MVP+|Mynetrix}} received a Midas' Sword with exactly {{c|50M}} coins paid.https://hypixel.net/threads/how-do-you-get-exactly-50-million-on-a-midas-sword.2408706/https://hypixel.net/attachments/wtf-png.1381381/ **{{RN|Staff|TimeDeo}} owns a Midas' Sword with {{c|1}} paid, granted to him by an admin.https://hypixel.net/threads/timedeo-has-a-1-coin-midas-sword.2953982/https://www.reddit.com/r/HypixelSkyblock/comments/gsmw9u/timedeo_has_a_possibly_glitched_item_in_his/ **{{RN|YouTube|Pigicial}} owns a Midas' Sword with {{c|49,999,999}} paid.https://hypixel.net/threads/how-did-pigicial-get-a-49-999-999-mil-midas.3162532/ *The highest possible bid on a '''Midas' Sword''' is {{c|2,146,000,000}}, which is just {{c|1,483,647}} shy of the 32-bit integer limit. **Due to the [[Dark Auction]] having fixed bid increments, the next bid option would be a negative amount of coins, which cannot be chosen because it is lower than the highest bid. **It is not possible to increase the price paid for a '''Midas' Sword''' beyond {{c|250m}} using {{NPCSprite|Zarina}}. *This sword is a reference to King Midas, a figure from Greek mythology. He was granted one wish and to pick to turn everything he touched to gold. When he killed his daughter by turning her to gold, he realized he had been blinded by greed, which this sword's ability references. **The [[Midas Staff]] and [[King Midas]] miniboss also reference him. *The {{ReforgingLink|Gilded}} reforge can be applied to this sword using a [[Midas Jewel]], increasing its {{Statname|Damage}} and {{Statname|Strength}}, and granting it a small chance to grant coins to nearby players upon killing mobs. *In the past, when {{Ench|One For All}} buffed weapon base damage, it did not work on the bonus damage provided by the {{Gold|Greed}} ability. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2024/Jun 3|[[File:Midas' Sword (v1).png|26px]] '''Midas' Sword''' can be upgraded with [[Golden Fragment]]s.}} {{History|2024/Jun 6|Increased base {{Stat|dmg}} from {{Red|150}} -> {{Red|170}}.|Buffed the {{AN|Greed}} ability from {{Red|+175}} to {{Red|+225}} max {{Stat|dmg}} and {{Stat|str}} when fragged.|[[Star Upgrades]] now scale with the {{AN|Greed}} Ability.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Midas' Sword (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Midas' Sword''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|2019/Jul 2|[[File:Midas' Sword (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Midas' Sword'''.}} {{History|2019/Jul 9|+40 Strength and Damage (from 80 to 120) at 50M coins.|Players can now out-bid themselves when the item is a Midas' Sword.}} {{History|2021/Mar 30|'''Midas' Sword''' {{Skl|Catacombs}} requirements lowered to 17, essence cost upgrade reduced to 100 and 25/50/75/125/200 {{Item|Gold Essence}} per star.}} {{History|0.20.3|'''Midas' Sword''' can now be upgraded with {{Item|Golden Fragment}}s.}} {{History|0.21|Removed NPC sell price.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Midas' Sword (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Midas' Sword''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Swords}} {{Nav/Dark Auction}} [[Category:Dark Auction]] [[Category:Melee Weapons]] [[Category:Pages with math equations]]
